section_summary.extract_value: This section details bivariate and ANCOVA analyses comparing heterosexual and sexual minority women. It identifies significant differences between these two groups in age, BMI, sexual relationship status, and education level. The ANCOVA, controlling for these variables, found a statistically significant difference in Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) scores, with sexual minority women having higher adjusted mean scores than heterosexual women.
